decisions.reason: ACE3 is a core ALCMS platform presented on its own page and positioned as a new industry standard, its uncertainty is largely resolved in its favor, and dropping it would sacrifice a strategic option in the firm's core airfield lighting business.

The air situation display moved from a mention to a dedicated page and is cheap to maintain as part of the surveillance portfolio, so keeping the option open while airport demand recovers after COVID makes sense.
A training program costs little to keep, complements installed systems, and its value is still uncertain under pandemic travel limits, so the option is worth holding.
The AGL training course was only mentioned rather than featured, but it is low cost and tied to the core lighting business, so abandoning it before demand resolves is premature.
Collaboration software has uncertain uptake given airport budget cuts, but maintenance costs are modest and the digital A-CDM option could pay off as traffic recovers.
The MLAT system was launched prominently with a dedicated page and extends the firm's surveillance offering, so the option should be kept while market evidence accumulates.
